# Memories

This mod adds the required packages the Memories nextcloud app needs to work.

Add it to the `nextcloud` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:nextcloud-memories
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:nextcloud-memories|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/nextcloud-memories/
